title: Open iEEG Dataset (Pediatric iEEG, Wayne State University and UCLA)
description: This dataset contains interictal intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings acquired during sleep from 185 de-identified pediatric epilepsy patients at UCLA Mattel Children's Hospital and Children's Hospital of Michigan. Per-subject folders include channel information, anatomical labels and resection status, and participant-level outcomes and background information. Derivatives include high-frequency oscillation (HFO) detections from RMS and MNI detectors, along with bipolar iEEG data used in a related study.
methods_description: Interictal iEEG recordings were collected during sleep from pediatric epilepsy patients at UCLA Mattel Children's Hospital and Children's Hospital of Michigan. Subject-wise data includes channel names, anatomical labels, and resection status. HFO detection derivatives were generated using RMS and MNI detectors. Bipolar iEEG data used in a related time-frequency analysis study are also provided.
